limitations: Supervised distillation reuses67.1M teacher real moves and25.7615 attempt chip-hours; it is not an independent RL sample-efficiency improvement.
Held-out episodes come from four fixed teacher populations. Exact action sequences/positions can repeat across episodes. No unseen-player, human-strength or opponent-level calibration claim.
The test split was inspected during short implementation qualifications; future confirmatory strength and style tests need fresh games.
No KataGo data used for training. No playing-strength, MCTS-integration, multi-step acceptance or TPU throughput claim follows from prediction losses alone.

loss_contract.behavior: Observed action NLL on independently sampled archived episodes, including capped histories, with stopped gradient at expert trunk
loss_contract.expert: Cross entropy against terminal-game MCTS policy distributions
loss_contract.optimizer: Plain-JAX AdamW, lr3e-4,128 warmup then cosine to10%, beta(.9,.95), eps1e-8, weight_decay.01 on matrices only, clip1.
loss_contract.value: Mean squared terminal side-to-move win outcome on expert games only

primary.criterion: All four ranks complete and agree on every parameter and Adam state. Final fixed-budget validation expert KL is at most80% of initialization and behavior NLL at most90%. Both must hold. This is a feasibility screen, with no population uncertainty claim.

secondary: Exact global expert/behavior token exposures, learner/CPU/wall times and full teacher cost
Unmasked illegal probability on expert positions, requiring later exact-native legality at execution
selection: Final4096 checkpoint only; fixed learning rate/schedule and seed before launch. No checkpoint selection or hyperparameter search.
